description: Seller: change one of your listings — price, what is available, title, description, lead time, endpoint or acceptance criteria. Applies to orders placed after it; formed contracts keep their terms.

acceptance.description: New acceptance criteria for future orders (JSON or a file; "none" removes them).

as.description: Practice market only: act as this party id.

available.description: Units left to sell from now (0 pauses orders; withdraw closes the listing).

demo.description: Use the practice market on this computer (nothing published, no real money).

endpoint.description: Paid agents: new https endpoint ("none" removes it).

network.description: Which market (default testnet). Validate on testnet, then use mainnet (real XRP).

name: market_update
